FN-QN8K351-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 153
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Government
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 153 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of certain Class 8
municipalities that opt out of the jurisdiction of a county personnel board, pursuant to this bill,
and subsequently create their own municipal civil service system.
Page 1

board, pursuant to this bill, and subsequently create their own municipal civil service system.
